title: Four-model synthetic performance across six outcome-horizon cells
population: Four reference models evaluated on three fixed roots from one public synthetic generator.
metric: Cellwise NRMSE: RMSE divided by that cell's population SD; three root values and the stored root mean are shown.
units: NRMSE dimensionless; force target N/kg and net-impulse target m/s remain separate cells.
grouping: Four reference models × three horizons × two outcomes × three fixed evaluation roots.
sample_sizes: Each root has 16 camps, 4,000 episodes, and 12,000 horizon rows; 4,000 rows per outcome-horizon cell.
uncertainty: No confidence interval; root points and their stored mean show descriptive variation across these three fixed same-generator roots.
caption_tex: Existing public fixed-mode synthetic benchmark across six outcome-horizon cells. Each panel shows the three fixed evaluation roots and their stored means for the zero-innovation baseline, training-mean baseline, ridge regression, and structured comparator. Root symbols are jittered horizontally only to separate marks; they remain within their model group. Rows are H24, H48, and H72; columns are peak mean-force innovation and net-impulse innovation. The force outcome maps to a target field for relative mean concentric-force innovation. Force targets are in \(\mathrm{N\,kg^{-1}}\) and impulse targets in \(\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}\); the vertical axis is cellwise NRMSE (dimensionless). Each root contains 16 camps and 4,000 rows per outcome-horizon cell. Points and stored means describe three fixed roots, not a confidence interval; all roots share one generator and are not human cohorts.
